title: a whitespace-only adm satisfies the presence check and is never flagged as missing
specRef: https://github.com/InteractiveAdvertisingBureau/openrtb2.x/blob/403cbba542de3a5d9cfcccd0a34e74b01b79a9f1/2.6.md#objectbid — Bid.adm is documented as carrying the actual ad markup; a string containing only whitespace carries none, but packages/core/helpers.js isStr() only tests `typeof === 'string' && length > 0`, so response.bid.payload_missing cannot see the difference between real markup and three space characters.

knownGap.note: A whitespace-only Bid.adm (with no nurl) passes the isStr() presence check unchanged, so response.bid.payload_missing never fires and no other rule reports the bid as carrying a blank creative.

specNotes: Browser measured on 2026-09-08 in run ortbtools-audit-9fSncA; only the exact observed product deviations are admitted. Normative finding and successful-analysis assertions are retained.

The documented classifier maps a blank body to unidentified/empty body. The browser verifies the exact whitespace in the inert text body and the absence of an iframe, images or media; no creative identity exists in this intentionally blank input. The validation finding is still required and remains DEF-198.
